hair-transplant.title: Hair Transplant
hair-transplant.shortDescription: Natural-looking hair restoration with FUE, DHI and Sapphire techniques.
hair-transplant.metaTitle: Hair Transplant (FUE, DHI, Sapphire) — Grafta Clinic Istanbul
hair-transplant.metaDescription: Natural results in hair transplant with FUE, DHI and Sapphire FUE techniques. Expert team, certified clinic. Free consultation at Grafta Clinic.
hair-transplant.heroSubtitle: Stop hair loss with FUE, DHI and Sapphire FUE techniques. A natural, permanent hairline using your own follicles.
hair-transplant.description: Hair transplant is the procedure of relocating healthy follicles, typically harvested from the donor area at the back of the scalp, to areas of thinning or recession. At Grafta Clinic we apply FUE, DHI and Sapphire FUE techniques and select the most suitable method for each patient, preserving the natural angle and density of hair.
benefits: High graft capacity in a single session

process.description: Hairline design, donor area assessment and technique selection.
Local anaesthesia and donor area preparation.
Follicles harvested one by one with a micromotor.
Micro-channels created with the natural direction and angle.
Follicles implanted with a DHI pen or implanter.
Long-term follow-up at month 1, 3, 6 and 12.

faq.question: Will there be visible scars?
faq.answer: FUE and DHI techniques do not leave a visible scar. Pinpoint marks in the donor area fade quickly.

faq.question: When will results show?
faq.answer: New hair starts growing from month 3-4; final result becomes visible by month 12.

faq.question: Will the transplanted hair fall out?
faq.answer: Grafts taken from genetically resistant areas are permanent; the initial 'shock loss' in the first weeks is normal.

faq.question: How long does the operation take?
faq.answer: Typically 6-8 hours, depending on the number of grafts.

beard-transplant.title: Beard Transplant
beard-transplant.shortDescription: A permanent solution for sparse or patchy beard areas via FUE.
beard-transplant.metaDescription: Beard transplant for sparse areas with natural density. FUE technique, expert surgeon, lasting result. Free consultation at Grafta Clinic.
beard-transplant.heroSubtitle: A permanent solution with natural direction and density for genetic or scar-related sparse beard areas.
beard-transplant.description: Beard transplant is mostly performed with the FUE technique. Grafts harvested from the donor area are placed in the beard region following the correct angle and direction. The result is natural and shavable.

process.description: Beard line drawn following facial proportions.
Suitable grafts selected from the donor area.
Follicles harvested with a micromotor.
Each follicle placed at the natural angle.
Aftercare and follow-up in the first week.

faq.question: Can I shave after a beard transplant?
faq.answer: Yes, transplanted hairs can be shaved comfortably from month 6.

faq.question: Is it painful?
faq.answer: The procedure is painless under local anaesthesia.

faq.question: When will I see the final result?
faq.answer: Final density and naturalness appear at months 8-12.

eyebrow-transplant.title: Eyebrow Transplant
eyebrow-transplant.shortDescription: Natural density for the brow line: a permanent restoration.
eyebrow-transplant.metaDescription: Eyebrow transplant for thin, sparse or scar-affected brows. Micro-design, expert surgeon, permanent result. Grafta Clinic.
eyebrow-transplant.heroSubtitle: Permanent restoration with natural direction and density for brows lost to genetics, trauma or over-plucking.
eyebrow-transplant.description: In eyebrow transplant, single follicular units harvested from the donor area are placed in the brow region at micro-angles. The outcome is harmonious with facial expression, naturally dense and permanent.

process.description: Drawing aligned with facial proportions and approval.
Single follicles collected.
Implantation observing direction and angle.
Reviews at month 1, 3 and 6.

faq.question: Will the eyebrow hairs grow?
faq.answer: Yes, since they originate from the donor area; they grow like hair and need regular trimming.

faq.question: How many follicles are needed?
faq.answer: Usually 200-400 follicles for both brows.

alopecia-treatment.title: Alopecia Treatment
alopecia-treatment.shortDescription: A dermatological and medical approach to localised hair loss.
alopecia-treatment.metaDescription: Dermatological care, intralesional injections and combination protocols for alopecia areata. Under specialist supervision.
alopecia-treatment.heroSubtitle: Scientific, individually tailored treatment protocols for autoimmune-related localised hair loss.
alopecia-treatment.description: Alopecia areata is an autoimmune condition presenting as round or oval patches of hair loss on the scalp. Treatment includes dermatological assessment, intralesional steroid injections when appropriate, topical therapies and combinations with PRP/mesotherapy.

process.description: Dermoscopy and laboratory tests where needed.
Subtype classification (areata, totalis, universalis).
Selection of intralesional or topical therapy.
Monthly reviews with plan adjustments.

faq.question: Does alopecia come back?
faq.answer: With the right treatment, regrowth is achieved in most patients; recurrences are possible in some cases.

faq.question: How long does the treatment take?
faq.answer: Typically 3-12 months depending on the subtype.

prp-therapy.title: PRP Therapy
prp-therapy.shortDescription: Hair and skin rejuvenation with plasma derived from your own blood.
prp-therapy.metaDescription: Stop hair loss and renew your skin with PRP. Growth factors derived from your own blood. Specialist supervision.
prp-therapy.heroSubtitle: Strengthen hair follicles and skin with platelet-rich plasma obtained from your own blood.
prp-therapy.description: In PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy, platelet-rich plasma separated from the patient's own blood via centrifugation is microinjected into areas with hair loss or signs of ageing. The growth factors support follicular nourishment and tissue renewal.
benefits: From your own blood — zero allergy risk

process.description: A small blood sample is taken.
Plasma is separated from the platelets.
Microinjections into the scalp or skin.
Usually 3-4 sessions, then maintenance.

faq.question: Is PRP painful?
faq.answer: Discomfort is minimal with topical anaesthesia.

faq.question: How often is it needed?
faq.answer: Initially 3-4 sessions every 2-4 weeks, then a refresher every 6 months.

mesotherapy.title: Mesotherapy
mesotherapy.shortDescription: Nourishing vitamin/mineral cocktails for hair and skin.
mesotherapy.metaDescription: Personalised vitamin/amino acid cocktails for hair loss and skin renewal via mesotherapy. Grafta Clinic specialists.
mesotherapy.heroSubtitle: Combinations of vitamins, amino acids and hyaluronic acid that nourish hair follicles and skin.
mesotherapy.description: Mesotherapy is the application of bespoke cocktails into the scalp or face via micro-needles. It is effective in slowing down hair loss and restoring radiance and hydration to the skin.
benefits: Quick application, immediate return to social life

process.description: Cocktail selection based on skin/hair analysis.
Superficial injections via micro-needles.
Typically once a week, 4-6 sessions.

faq.question: Are there side effects?
faq.answer: Apart from temporary redness, side effects are rare.

faq.question: When will results appear?
faq.answer: After 1-2 sessions for skin, after 4-6 sessions for hair.

fillers-botox.title: Fillers & Botox
fillers-botox.shortDescription: Injectables that smooth lines and restore volume.
fillers-botox.metaTitle: Botox and Filler Treatments — Grafta Clinic
fillers-botox.metaDescription: Soften expression lines with Botox, restore volume with fillers. Natural results, expert specialist. Grafta Clinic Istanbul.
fillers-botox.heroSubtitle: Medical aesthetic injectables that preserve a natural look while addressing expression lines and volume loss.
fillers-botox.description: Botox softens the lines on the forehead, between the brows and around the eyes. Hyaluronic acid fillers add natural volume to the cheekbones, lips, chin and cheeks. All treatments are administered under specialist supervision using certified products.

process.description: Facial analysis and treatment map.
Precise injection with fine-tip needles.
Day 10-14 review with optional touch-ups.

faq.question: How long does Botox last?
faq.answer: Typically 4-6 months, after which it can be repeated.

faq.question: Are fillers permanent?
faq.answer: Hyaluronic acid fillers are absorbed by the body within 6-18 months.

youth-vaccine.title: Youth Vaccine
youth-vaccine.shortDescription: A bio-regenerative treatment for skin elasticity and glow.
youth-vaccine.metaDescription: Restore skin structure from within with the youth vaccine. Profhilo and similar bio-regenerative applications. Grafta Clinic.
youth-vaccine.heroSubtitle: Bio-regenerative treatments that support the skin's own collagen production from within.
youth-vaccine.description: The youth vaccine is the application of cocktails containing hyaluronic acid and multiple vitamins/amino acids (e.g. NCTF, Profhilo) that diffuse across the layers of the skin and support collagen and elastin production. It is not a permanent filler — it repairs the skin's own structure.
benefits: Effective on neck and hands as well

process.description: Assessing the skin's age and needs.
Microinjections distributed on the surface.
Typically two sessions, four weeks apart.

faq.question: How long does it last?
faq.answer: The first series lasts 6-9 months; an annual maintenance is recommended.

faq.question: Who is it suitable for?
faq.answer: From the late twenties onward, anyone wishing to maintain skin elasticity.

rhinoplasty.title: Rhinoplasty
rhinoplasty.shortDescription: A surgical plan for a natural nose in harmony with your face.
rhinoplasty.metaDescription: Functional and aesthetic excellence with rhinoplasty. Open and closed techniques, expert plastic surgeon. Grafta Clinic.
rhinoplasty.heroSubtitle: Natural, harmonious results in line with your facial features — function and aesthetics together.
rhinoplasty.description: Rhinoplasty is plastic surgery aimed at altering the shape, size or function of the nose. At Grafta Clinic the procedure is planned with both open and closed techniques, considering both aesthetics and breathing function. In cases requiring septoplasty, a combined treatment is possible.

process.description: 3D analysis and assessment of facial proportions.
Choosing open/closed technique, aligning expectations.
General anaesthesia, 2-3 hour procedure.
Splint for the first week, social return in 7-10 days.
Reviews at month 1, 3, 6 and 12.

faq.question: When are the results final?
faq.answer: Visible improvement in 1 month; final result by month 12.

faq.question: What is the recovery time?
faq.answer: Social life in 7-10 days; sports in 4-6 weeks.

faq.question: Are both techniques permanent?
faq.answer: Yes, both techniques deliver permanent results.

breast-aesthetics.shortDescription: Expert surgery for augmentation, reduction and lift.
breast-aesthetics.metaTitle: Breast Aesthetics (Augmentation, Reduction, Lift) — Grafta Clinic
breast-aesthetics.metaDescription: Augmentation, reduction and lift for breast aesthetics. CE/FDA-certified implants, expert plastic surgeon. Grafta Clinic.

breast-aesthetics.description: Breast aesthetics covers different techniques such as augmentation, reduction and mastopexy (lift). The technique of choice depends on the patient's anatomy, skin structure and expectations. At Grafta Clinic, only CE/FDA-certified implants are used.

faq.question: How long do implants last?
faq.answer: Modern implants can last 10-15 years or longer; routine check-ups are advised.

faq.question: Will it affect breastfeeding?
faq.answer: When the right technique is chosen, breastfeeding is generally not affected.

intro.title: Why Turkey is the world's #1 destination for hair transplant
intro.body: Every year more than 750,000 international patients travel to Turkey for hair restoration. Istanbul alone hosts hundreds of clinics — but only a small fraction operate to international medical standards, employ board-certified surgeons, and publish transparent results. This guide explains what separates the best hair transplant clinic in Turkey from the rest, and why patients from the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, the Gulf and beyond consistently choose Grafta Clinic Istanbul.

whyTurkey.title: Why a hair transplant in Turkey costs less — without compromising on quality
whyTurkey.subtitle: Patients often ask whether the price difference between the United States, the United Kingdom and Turkey reflects a quality gap. It does not. The price gap reflects local cost structure: lower clinic operating costs, lower physician overhead, a competitive medical-tourism market, and government incentives for accredited health-tourism providers. The actual technology, techniques and surgeon training are the same — and in many cases superior — to what is offered in New York, Miami, Los Angeles, London or Berlin.

whyGrafta.title: What makes Grafta Clinic the best hair transplant clinic in Istanbul
whyGrafta.subtitle: Eight non-negotiable standards that separate us from high-volume "hair mills".

items.title: Surgeon-led procedure — never technician-only
items.description: Your hairline design, channel opening and graft extraction are performed personally by a board-certified surgeon. Many clinics in Turkey delegate the entire procedure to technicians; we do not. Our surgeons are members of ISHRS and FUE Europe.

items.title: Maximum 1 patient per surgeon per day
items.description: We deliberately limit ourselves to one operation per surgeon per day. This guarantees full attention, no rushed graft handling, and the lowest possible follicle damage rate (under 5%, vs. industry average of 15-25%).

items.title: FUE, DHI and Sapphire FUE — chosen for you, not for us
items.description: We offer all three techniques. We recommend the one that suits your hairline pattern, donor area and goals — never the one with the highest margin for the clinic.

items.title: ISO 9001 certified facility, JCI-aligned protocols
items.description: Hospital-grade operating theatres, single-use medical instruments, microbiological audits, CE/FDA-approved equipment only. We publish our certification numbers; many competitors do not.

items.title: Authorized health-tourism provider
items.description: Officially registered with the Turkish Ministry of Health for international patient care (license number disclosed on consultation). This is a regulated status with audited compliance.

items.title: Written guarantee with free revision clause
items.description: If your graft survival rate falls below the agreed threshold at month 12, we perform a free revision session. The guarantee is contractual, not a marketing slogan.

items.title: Lifetime follow-up — by your surgeon, not a call centre
items.description: Free check-ups at month 1, 3, 6 and 12. After that, direct WhatsApp access to your surgeon for years. Most international clinics drop contact after week 2.

items.title: Transparent pricing — no upsells on the day
items.description: The price quoted in your free consultation is the price you pay. We do not 'discover' you need more grafts on the operation day, a tactic some Istanbul clinics are well-known for.

techniques.title: Hair transplant techniques we offer
techniques.subtitle: All three modern techniques are performed in-house. The right choice depends on your donor area, hairline goal and lifestyle preferences.

items.name: Sapphire FUE
items.description: Channels are opened with sapphire-tipped blades instead of steel. Smaller incisions, denser packing, and faster healing — typically the best choice for patients seeking maximum density in the frontal hairline.

items.name: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation)
items.tagline: No shaving required for women & unshaven cases
items.description: Choi implanter pens place each graft directly without pre-cut channels. Ideal for women, mid-density refinement, and patients who prefer not to shave the recipient area.

items.name: Classic FUE
items.tagline: Highest graft yield in a single session
items.description: The proven workhorse technique. Best for large session sizes (4,500-6,000 grafts), Norwood 5-7 patterns, and patients prioritising graft volume over recovery speed.

items.name: Afro Hair Transplant
items.description: Afro and curly hair has follicles that curve below the skin — extracting them without transection requires specialist tools and surgeon experience. We have a dedicated afro hair protocol with documented outcomes for Black men and women.

items.name: Women's Hair Transplant
items.description: Female hair restoration requires different planning: diffuse thinning patterns, hormonal evaluation, and unshaven DHI to preserve dignity during recovery. Our female-patient protocol includes a dedicated female surgeon when requested.

items.name: HIV+ Friendly Protocol
items.description: We accept HIV-positive patients with controlled viral load and follow universal sterile precautions identical to those used for every patient. Many Turkish clinics quietly refuse — we do not. Discretion guaranteed.

journey.title: Your hair transplant journey, day by day

steps.title: Free pre-evaluation
steps.description: Send 4 photos via WhatsApp. The surgeon reviews them personally and replies with a graft estimate, technique recommendation and total cost — usually within 24 hours. No deposit, no pressure.

steps.title: Welcome & in-person consultation
steps.description: Driver meets you at Istanbul airport. Quick rest at the hotel, then in-person consultation at the clinic: hairline design, donor area assessment, blood tests. Free dinner reservation if you'd like.

steps.title: The procedure
steps.description: 9:00 AM start. Local anaesthesia, graft extraction, channel opening, implantation. 6-8 hours with breaks. Lunch served. You leave the clinic on your own feet, head bandaged. Driver waits to take you back.

steps.title: First wash and aftercare briefing
steps.description: Return to the clinic for the first medical wash, photo documentation and recovery kit handover. The surgeon explains every step of home care. Driver to airport. You're home for dinner.

intro.title: Why so many Turkish clinics quietly say no — and why we don't
intro.body: Many international patients living with HIV report being either openly refused or 'lost in follow-up' once they disclose their status to a Turkish hair transplant clinic. The reasons cited usually frame HIV as a 'staff safety' or 'sterilization' concern. Both are medically and legally inaccurate. Modern hair transplant procedures already use single-use punches, single-use needles and universal precautions for every patient — irrespective of viral status. Refusing care to a person living with HIV violates Turkish medical ethics regulations. At Grafta Clinic we apply the same standard of care as for any other patient: HIV-positive patients with controlled viral load are treated identically to any other patient — no separate room, no separate day, no extra cost, no marked file.

medicalReality.title: The medical reality: HIV does not change the hair transplant protocol
medicalReality.subtitle: Three facts every reputable surgeon already knows.

items.title: Universal precautions apply to everyone
items.description: Single-use punches, single-use needles, sterilized instruments, gloves changed between cases — these are mandatory standards for every patient regardless of HIV, HBV or HCV status. There is no 'extra' protocol; the standard protocol already protects everyone.

items.title: Outcomes are equivalent
items.description: Peer-reviewed evidence consistently shows that graft survival, healing time and final density in patients with controlled HIV (CD4 above 350, undetectable viral load on stable antiretroviral therapy) are statistically identical to HIV-negative cohorts.

items.title: The legal duty of care is absolute
items.description: Turkish Patient Rights Regulation and Medical Deontology Regulation explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of disease status. Refusing a hair transplant to a patient with controlled HIV is unlawful in Turkey.

ourProtocol.title: Our HIV-positive patient protocol — clinically the same, with extra discretion
ourProtocol.subtitle: We do not need a 'special' clinical pathway. We do offer a heightened privacy pathway.

items.title: Pre-op review of bloodwork
items.description: We ask for recent (within 90 days) CD4 count, viral load and confirmation of antiretroviral therapy. This is the standard pre-op review we run for every patient with chronic medical conditions — diabetes, hypertension, autoimmune disease — not specific to HIV.

items.title: Same surgeon, same theatre, same day
items.description: You are not scheduled separately or last in the day. You receive the same surgeon, the same operating theatre and the same instruments as every patient — because nothing about the procedure changes.

items.description: Your status is recorded only in your encrypted patient file accessible to your surgeon and anaesthetist. No outside-of-room marking. Reception, drivers, hotel staff and interpreters never see your medical file.

legalProtection.title: Your legal protection in Turkey
legalProtection.body: Turkey applies strict patient privacy laws under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK), which classifies health information as a 'special category' of personal data with the highest level of legal protection. Discrimination on the basis of HIV status is explicitly prohibited under the Patient Rights Regulation and the Medical Deontology Regulation. A clinic that refuses you because of HIV status is breaking the law — you have the right to file a complaint with the Ministry of Health and the KVKK Authority. We mention this not to alarm you, but so you know your rights.

faq.title: FAQ — HIV+ hair transplant in Turkey

items.question: Will I be charged extra because I'm HIV-positive?
items.answer: No. Charging extra would be discrimination. Our pricing is identical to every other patient: from $2,950 all-inclusive for Sapphire FUE, from $1,950 for Essential FUE.

items.question: Do I need to disclose my status to the hotel, driver or interpreter?
items.answer: No. Your status is medical information and is shared only with your surgeon and anaesthetist on a need-to-know basis. The hotel sees a name and reservation; the driver sees a pickup; the interpreter sees a consultation. None of them have access to your medical file.

items.question: What CD4 count and viral load are required?
items.answer: We apply the internationally accepted criteria: CD4 ≥ 350 and an undetectable viral load on stable antiretroviral therapy for at least 3 months. Patients outside these thresholds receive an individual surgeon review — outright refusal is not our default.

items.question: Will the surgical team know my status?
items.answer: Yes — your surgeon and anaesthetist see your full medical file. This is mandatory for safe care. They are bound by Turkish medical confidentiality law and our internal NDA. No one else in the clinic chain has access.

items.question: Are there higher complication risks?
items.answer: Peer-reviewed evidence shows no statistically significant difference in graft survival, infection rate or healing time for HIV-positive patients on stable ART. We track this directly in our outcomes audit.

items.question: What if I'm also HBV or HCV positive?
items.answer: Same answer: universal precautions cover all bloodborne pathogens. We accept HBV and HCV positive patients on the same terms. Co-infections require closer pre-op review of liver function.

items.question: Can I pay discreetly?
items.answer: Bank transfer, credit card and cash are all available. Invoice line items can be labeled 'aesthetic procedure' rather than 'hair transplant' on request. We do not require travel insurance disclosure.

items.question: Is this even legal in Turkey?
items.answer: Yes — explicitly. Refusing care because of HIV status is unlawful under Turkish Patient Rights Regulation and Medical Deontology Regulation. Performing the procedure with proper precautions and informed consent is fully legal.

items.question: What if my partner or family doesn't know my status?
items.answer: They do not need to know. You can travel alone, or with a companion who is told only the cosmetic context. We have full experience caring for patients who maintain privacy from family or partners.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: Identical timeline: shedding at month 1, new growth from month 3-4, density visible by month 6, final result by month 12. HIV status does not change recovery.

items.question: Why don't more clinics in Turkey accept HIV+ patients?
items.answer: Mostly outdated training and unfounded staff anxiety. The medical reality has been settled for over two decades; many clinics simply have not updated their internal policies. We made the conscious decision to follow current evidence and Turkish law.

items.question: How do I start the conversation?
items.answer: Send a message via your preferred channel. State only what you choose to state — even just 'I have an immune condition I'd like to discuss' is enough to begin. Our intake team is trained to respect your pace of disclosure.
